newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Compared with Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand light, instances moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
